name: Lisa Banes
bio: Lisa Banes (July 9, 1955 – June 14, 2021) was born in Chagrin Falls, Ohio, USA. She was an American actress, known for Gone Girl (2014), A Cure for Wellness (2016) and Cocktail (1988). She died on June 14, 2021 in New York City, New York, after suffering brain damage from a hit-and-run scooter accident on June 4th.
